articles.summary: PEMBROKE, Bermuda, Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - AXIS Capital Holdings Limited (“AXIS Capital” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AXS) today announced that it expects to release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 after the close of the financial markets.
